header: Types shared by the server (omnibar.ts) and the browser (Nl2SqlAnswerExtras.tsx, useOmniSearch.ts). I keep this file free of any server-only import so that the browser bundle can use it.

members.name: total
doc: The true number of rows the query produces; the rows themselves may be capped for display.

symbols.name: CircularSource
doc: This holds the extra information that travels with an answer written by the language model. A circular an answer was read from, for the "Source" line under the answer; a click opens it in the circular viewer.

members.name: circularId
doc: public.circulars.id: what the viewer opens

members.name: label
doc: Looks like "Circular 003 (2024)": the number the archive shows, and its year

members.name: title
doc: the circular's headline

members.name: pages
doc: 1-based pages of the circular on which the people in the answer are listed: the viewer scrolls to the first and marks them all. Empty means unknown.

members.name: logId
doc: The row in public.nl2sql_log that the tick/cross uses.

members.name: userKey
doc: The asker (ticket number) the log row belongs to; I echo it back with the tick/cross.

members.name: sql
doc: The exact SQL the model wrote; I show it collapsed, so a reader can check it.

members.name: elapsedMs
doc: How long the whole answer took, in milliseconds: model call(s) plus database.

members.name: scope
doc: The departments the answer's department filter really matched, computed from the SQL by the system.

members.name: table
doc: The rows and columns the SQL returned; present for every answer except a single plain number.

members.name: canPage
doc: True when more rows exist beyond the ones sent and "Show more" can fetch them: this is for a signed-in person, 100 at a time.

members.name: display
doc: How to present them: the model's suggestion VERIFIED against the real result (display.ts), or a layout I choose from the data's shape.

members.name: verifiedBy
doc: Set only when the answer is a VERIFIED answer; it holds how many confirmations it has. In that case I do not call the model.

members.name: retryAttempt
doc: Holds 2, 3 ... when this is another attempt after a "No".

members.name: sources
doc: The circular(s) a health check-up answer was read from: one per circular, in the order they appear in the answer.

members.name: plainAnswer
doc: True when `answer` is a sentence written for this question (an empty health check-up answer), not a row count; the screen then leaves out the big number above it.

members.name: sourceNote
doc: I show this with the Source line when someone listed is not in the HR directory (their ticket is as printed in the circular). Absent when everybody is.

members.name: departmentNote
doc: What I took a department word in the question to mean ("Refractory" = all three Refractory departments ...); shown under "Departments covered" (step 55a).

members.name: spellingNote
doc: I set this when nobody was found and the name words were replaced by the nearest real spellings: "No name is spelled “Gosyami” (nearest: Goswami): ..." (step 55b).
